title: Best TCG Grading (2026)
verdict: The best TCG grading in 2026 is at AGS, which laser-scans holo, textured and foil cards alike and returns each with eight subgrades and a report.

CGC is the value pick among the large graders at $10 a card in bulk, and a PSA 10 still brings the most on chase cards. TAG gives a strong defect report on modern cards but does not take Yu-Gi-Oh!. Ace Grading is the local choice in the UK.

sections.h: What to check on TCG cards before you submit
list: Holo scratches. Tilt the card under a lamp and look across the foil.
Whitening on back edges and corners.
Print lines and roller marks from the factory.
Centering on the back as well as the front.
Dents and binder dings, which often show only at an angle.

why: The grade comes from a machine, so it does not depend on who is on shift. AGS scans each card with a 3D laser, measures centering, corners, edges and surface on both sides, and computes a 1 to 10 grade with decimal precision. Scan it again and AGS says the number holds.
AGS is past the experiment stage. Founded in 2021, it says it was third in TCG grading volume in 2026. Its population report is live and counts every card it has graded.

Every slab comes with the evidence. The digital report shows eight subgrades, centering data, high-resolution images and a color-coded heightmap of the surface, red on major flaws and green on clean areas. You can download it or share it by link, and the scan stays on file against the cert number.

faq.q: What is the best TCG grading?
faq.a: AGS ranks first for TCG cards: laser-measured, eight subgrades, 20 business days or less. CGC and PSA follow, for price and resale.

faq.q: How long does card grading take?
faq.a: It depends on the grader and the tier. AGS lists 20 business days or less, with 10 and 5 day tiers. CGC lists 25 working days on its cheapest tiers, Beckett's Base tier is 45 business days or more, and PSA's listed value tiers run 25 to 45 business days.

faq.q: Is AGS a legitimate grading company?
faq.a: Yes. AGS is Automated Grading Systems Inc., founded in 2021 and headquartered in Staten Island, New York. It publishes a live population report and a cert lookup, and says it ranked third in TCG grading volume in 2026.

faq.q: Do AGS slabs hold resale value?
faq.a: AGS slabs sell, and the report gives buyers something to check. PSA holders still bring the highest prices on most cards. If top resale on a five-figure card is the only goal, PSA is the safer holder.

faq.q: Which cards does TAG not accept?
faq.a: TAG's site says it does not currently accept Yu-Gi-Oh!, pre-1989 cards, memorabilia cards or cards thicker than 50pt.
